notes.title: Update #2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our second game update is now live! This one's more substantial than the first, here's the list:

Visual stuff
We've made a number of updates to various assets' art style, the map structure and other, smaller improvements.

 Updated terrain tiles including normal grass, corrupted grass and soil to match the new art style
 Expanded map with 2 new areas
 Updates to decorative assets such as stones and bushes with the new art style
 Added a shadow to the tree assets
 Added new decorative assets such as army crates, cut tree trunks and poison barrels
 The dark grass tiles found under the trees have been removed and replaced with normal grass tiles
 The tree layouts and heights have been chaged to make the map look more natural
 Added more decorative assets around the map
 Update Comet's idle animation with the new art style and a shadow
 Replaced the game title and menu fonts with a new, simpler and more crisp version
 Decluttered / simplified the character / level up menu 
 As a last point, the game now supports modified app display scales (the % value under "Scale and layout" in the "Display" settings), this means it will look crisp at any % rather than stretched or cropped and blurry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130784/759ed37518682792d6e8278b5ce301455ab3a19f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130784/4be281824a1edfcece26d68c259282e3b4f25984.png
Gameplay
We've added game saving mechanics! As the map grows and there's more to do, you'll be able to save your progress. Note that you will only be able to do so when not in combart, or when enemies are far away enough from you. Also, the game will also be automatically saved during checkpoints and your last saved will be loaded after a game over.

Sound
Not much other than to say we've rebalanced some sound effect volumes.

Bug fixes
We found that when a game over happened with enemies around, their collidable boxes would remain in place when the game reloaded; they're now removed correctly.

And that's it! Should you find any bugs please report them in the bugs forum thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3091610/discussions/0/4424309823751839958/


We hope you'll enjoy the addition and changes! If you want to contact us to let us know your thoughts or ask any questions, you can do so on the Steam forums or on discord: https://discord.gg/FRxCwcWuzy


You can also follow us on social media to keep up to date with our progress!

Until next time everyone, enjoy!

notes.title: Update #1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our first offical update has just dropped! It's a minor one for now, but we wanted to get the ball rolling!

Here are the changes:

Graphics
We're starting an overhaul to the game's overall art style, starting with the game's title and followed by most of the trees you'll see just about everywhere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130784/cd592092fe50b3d7ae1a6f57b2f87e88039b0462.png
Gameplay
We've speed up Comet's horizontal and vertical walking animations to move around the map quicker; the main issue we heard from beta testers was that it felt too sluggish.

Bug fixes

 The "Medkit!" text that shows up when you collect them now fades out gradually instead of just disappearing.
 The boss area entrance gate used to remain open after beating the game and starting a new one. Now it'll be closed properly.
 At the end of the boss sphere presentation cutscene the camera used to snap back to the player, it now stays focused on the sphere as the scene fades out, as it was meant to.

Background / Engine
On the techincal side we've make a number of background / engine improvements including:

 Better, more accurate error logging throughout the entire game to better help us keep track and debug any issues you might run into 
 Audio bugs will not crash the game any longer; you will be able to continue to play but you might have to mute the game if it starts misbehaving. 

That's all for now! 

Should you find any bugs please report them in the bugs forum thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3091610/discussions/0/4424309823751839958/


If you want to contact us to let us know your thoughts or ask any questions, you can do so on the Steam forums or on discord: https://discord.gg/FRxCwcWuzy


You can also follow us on social media to keep up to date with our progress!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/graa_games_studio/

Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@graa_games_studio

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@graa_games_studio


Until next time everyone, have fun!
